Thanks for the run-through earlier. Quick recap and our assumptions so we line up before I draft a formal quote: 

- Call notes: Finlytics expects to embed LLM features into reporting pipelines (batch + API calls). Rough cadence: higher daily peaks around 10-2pm ET.
- Volumes (provisional): target bucket of ~10-15M tokens / month (please confirm).
- Residency split: you mentioned EU data residency for initial EU customers — estimate ~25-35% of traffic landing in EU region.
- Pricing targets: you indicated a target $/1M tokens range in the discussion. For baseline reference, our US-hosted unit currently typical: $800 / 1M tokens (list shown for small committed tiers). EU-hosted endpoints generally carry a regional premium due to infra/ops — ballpark +15-20% depending on model/quantization (so estimate $920-$960 / 1M tokens).

Immediate asks: 
1) Confirm expected monthly token volume (best guess min/expected/max).
2) Confirm approximate EU residency % for first 6 months (we'll use 30% as the working assumption if not specified).
3) Any hard budget caps (monthly or per-feature) to watch for?

Next steps from our side: I'll assemble a two-line quote: (a) blended committed pricing with a 70/30 US/EU split and (b) a split-line quote showing separate US and EU unit prices. Will include commitment bands (3/12/24 months) and incremental volume breakpoints. Expect a draft in 24-36 hours — attaching a short regional-cost worksheet for visibility.

Attachments: regional-cost-breakdown.xlsx (workbook with unit price scenarios)

Thanks,
Ben

Appreciate the numbers — good to have a sharpened target. Attached is a quick sensitivity table (see regional-cost-breakdown.xlsx) but summarizing inline for the 12M baseline: 

Assumptions used:
- Baseline US unit: $800 / 1M tokens (committed 12-month band)
- EU premium applied: +18% (model/infra/ops blended) => EU unit $944 / 1M tokens
- Residency split used: 70% US / 30% EU => blended effective unit = (0.7*800 + 0.3*944) = $846.40 / 1M tokens

Estimated monthly spend (12M tokens):
- US tokens (8.4M) cost @800 => $6,720
- EU tokens (3.6M) cost @944 => $3,398.40
- Blended total monthly => $10,118.40 (blended $846.40 / 1M)

If we apply a 15% committed discount at a 24-month reserved level the blended effective drops to ~$719 / 1M equivalent (numbers in the workbook). Dedicated capacity in EU can reduce the premium vs managed EU hosting — depends on committed GPU footprint; I'll have Karthik model that variant for you (cc'd).

Next steps proposed: 
- I'll push a formal two-line PDF quote (blended + split-line) and the workbook by tomorrow morning.
- Proposed follow-up: Thu 18 Nov, 10:00 AM ET to review quote and procurement timeline (30 minutes). Does that work for your team?

Attachments: finlytics-proposal-v1.pdf (outline quote), regional-cost-breakdown.xlsx

Ben
